subject: stf
title: (R)STF.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 345 (PMBA-9). STF (source transfer) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics), PER-DY (perception dynamics) and ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From POL-DY: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From PER-DY: PRI-INFO (principle information). From ALT-FT: CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis). From APP-RDEF: POL-SIGN (political significance). From PRI-INFO: OBS (observation). From CULT-INFO-BS: MD-DY (media dynamics). From POL-SIGN: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From OBS: INFO-DY (information dynamics).
